description: This PHP class 'FormatWithMembershipId' implements a value formatter strategy to retrieve and return the name of a membership entity based on a provided membership ID, utilizing a MembershipService to fetch the data.

classes.name: FormatWithMembershipId
classes.description: A class that formats a value by retrieving the corresponding Membership's name using its ID.

methods.name: getFormattedValue
methods.description: Returns the name of the Membership entity for the given membership ID, or null if not found.

methods.name: getMembershipService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the MembershipService instance used to retrieve membership details.
